author: worker_1
belief: As of late November 2023, the population of Rosario, Argentina (city proper/municipality) based on the 2022 census was approximately 1,030,069 (or 1,029,619 according to some sources). The department population was 1,348,725.

author: worker_2
belief: As of late November 2023, the population of Barcelona, Spain (city proper/municipality) was approximately 1,660,435 (official municipal register as of January 1, 2023) or 1,701,891 (as of August 1, 2023). The city proper population is around 1.66-1.70 million.

author: worker_3
belief: As of late November 2023, the population of Paris, France (city proper/municipality) was approximately 2,103,778 (INSEE estimate as of January 1, 2023).

author: worker_4
belief: As of late November 2023, the population of Miami, Florida (city proper) was approximately 455,924 (U.S. Census Bureau July 1, 2023 estimate).
